parsed.rationale: Localized poison ivy contact dermatitis limited to forearms with no fever, breathing difficulty, facial/eye/genital involvement, or signs of infection. Manage with cool compresses, calamine/OTC hydrocortisone, oral antihistamine for itch, and washing exposed clothing/tools. Escalate if rash spreads widely, involves face/eyes/genitals, shows pus/increasing pain/fever, or fails to improve in 1-2 weeks.
